testCase.name: [local] S05 Server clock table: which day a visit's line is filed under (device clock −3 d / +1 d, and a finish across midnight)

descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · TFA-92589 AC 7; UAT 3.8 · ““Today” is based on server time, not device time”. Mixed: stated part — device clock −3 d / +1 d: one line per visit filed under the server's today; our part — the finish that crosses local midnight (N36) (only the stated part makes a QA bug).

Bug N36 · S1 · new

One visit gets two dates: the server note job files the visit under the UTC day (correct), but the pre-round and the device-side writes still use the device's local day, so between local and UTC midnight Hospital keeps a pending line plus the entry under another date, Nursing Home counts one visit twice, and medication holds are dated a day apart

Tickets: TFA-92589 · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: local (25acd727)

Note: TC-11/S05 midnight cell (the other 12 clock cells pass). The line is flipped under the date at the tap, and replaceTodayCourseLine appends under the new date when the course refresh returns after midnight. Re-test 2026-10-20 on 8b4be94a: changed: the device-midnight split is gone; seen live on dev at 03:55 JST (TC-11/S05; also TC-19/S11, S27, TC-17/S27 'Oct 19' summary, TC-13/S13 'Oct 19:' carried-forward line). convex/noteJobs.ts request: day = new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10). Quinn 2026-10-20: day / date rules are judged in UTC (server time); a label that shows the UTC day is correct. The fix direction is the pre-round side (UTC), not the job.

Approach · TC-11 Course Timeline · S05 Server clock table: which day a visit's line is filed under (device clock −3 d / +1 d, and a finish across midnight)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U9 'Today' on the timeline comes from the server clock, not the device's; a device with a wrong date, no clock set or a different time zone shows the same state as any other device. (UAT 3.8; TFA-92589 AC 7)
  • U1 One entry per completed visit, correctly dated, in chronological order, never duplicated. (UAT TC-11; TFA-92589 AC 3)

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Browser clock skewed against the server (page.clock) or a time zone whose midnight falls during the finish; ledgers seeded per cell; model calls mocked

When Per cell: {Hospital, Nursing Home} × {Pre-Round Save; Pre-Round Save then Generate; direct Generate} × device clock −3 d (and +1 d where sign-in works); plus a Hospital finish whose refresh returns after local midnight

Then Every visit has exactly one stored line, filed under the server's today, and no line under the device's day

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions on the stored ledger: one line for the visit, under the server's today, none under the device's day. Only the NH direct-Generate −3 d cell has a test on main; a Pass on S05 covers that cell only, and every other cell reports Blocked (not built) until its test exists. A +1 d cell that cannot sign in is a Fail against 3.8, cross-checked by S08. …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S05 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-11.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 0 rows.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: CODEREVIEW · Code review — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: newspec-c.

UAT item: TC-11 Course Timeline · Section: A2 · Pre-Round · Scenario: TC-11/S05

Server clock table: which day a visit's line is filed under (device clock −3 d / +1 d, and a finish across midnight)

Tickets: TFA-92589 Course Timeline (ready for qa)

New local lane newspec-c: status failed in newspec-c/results.json → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue)).

Detail:

rst-tc11-s05-clock-cells.spec.ts, local, every ai/* answered at the socket, every Generate with a custom procedure-other template (no billing job). The seven cells Tim's suite lacks plus a mocked copy of his one cell (NH direct Generate −3 d; his test stores a note with the SNF billing template, so it cannot run locally on 25acd727). −3 d (page.clock three days behind, server day Oct 16, device day Oct 13): Hospital and Nursing Home × Pre-Round Save / Save then Generate / direct Generate — 6/6 cells: exactly one line, filed under Oct 16, none under Oct 13 ('Visit 1 · Oct 16: …' / 'Oct 16: … ⏳ Encounter pending.' / finished 'Oct 16: <entry>'); 11/11 judged. +1 d (a second browser of the same physician a day ahead): the stored session was dropped by the device clock (B33, still), signing in through the form worked (UAT 3.8 judged: pass); then the same six cells 6/6, nothing under Oct 17; 12/12 judged. Midnight (FAILED): Hospital chart on a device in Etc/GMT+11 (no clock skew; the server's own time crosses the device's midnight at 11:00 UTC): Pre-Round Save at 23:58:00 wrote 'Oct 15: Breathing easier on 2 L. ⏳ Encounter pending.'; Generate at 23:59:00; the course refresh answered at 00:00:22 local -> the stored ledger has TWO lines for the one visit: 'Oct 15: Breathing easier on 2 L. Encounter done' and 'Oct 16: Note finished, plan unchanged' (the matrix judges one line; which day it carries is Q14, recorded). Cause in the code: useNoteGeneration flips today's line to 'Encounter done' under the label read at the tap (Oct 15) and replaceTodayCourseLine writes the refreshed entry under the label read when the refresh returns (Oct 16), appending a new line when that day has none (src/domain/courseTimeline.ts). New candidate (proposed P2). Tripwire: no model call in any run.

Product issue: A Hospital note finished just before the physician's local midnight (the timeline refresh comes back after midnight) leaves two Course Timeline lines for one visit: the day of the visit keeps a half-finished 'Breathing easier on 2 L. Encounter done' and the next day gets the finished entry, so the timeline shows a visit on a day the patient was not seen (both lines fall in the yesterday-and-today window, so both are on the cards).

Evidence: 5 attached.

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (Tim's spec for the one cell on main, e2e/course-timeline.spec.ts, plus our cells not written yet): page.clock / timezoneId on a fresh @roundai.test account seeded through e2e/support/backend.ts with the local admin key, with mocked model calls; dev has no admin key, one shared account and…. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).

This case has results elsewhere too (a case shows one result: a verdict beats blocked, a run beats a skip; within a tier the worse one, on a tie the earlier one (dev, dev lanes, local lane A/C, new local lanes), test out of date ranks above passed; when all are skips the dev one, unless dev only says "local only / can't run on dev" or gives the lane's own reason):

  • [dev newspec-c] failed (newspec-c/results.json) — newspec-c: failed → failed (failed (the lane flagged no product issue)) N36 re-check on 8b4be94a: CHANGED. The device-midnight split is gone with the server job, but one visit now leaves two ledger lines whenever the physician's day and the server's UTC day differ (00:00-09:00 in Tokyo): the pre-round Save writes the device-zone day ('Oct 20: … ⏳ Encounter pending.' / 'Visit 1 · Oct 20: …') and t…
  • [local matrix (lane A)] passed (matrix/TC-11.results.json)
